description: Banking transaction list where tapping a transaction reveals its reference details.

import { ArrowDownLeftIcon, ArrowUpRightIcon, ReceiptIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/collapsible" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const transactions = [ { id: "t1", merchant: "Corner Bakery", category: "Food", amount: -8.4, date: "Nov 14", ref: "POS 4471 · Card ending 2290", }, { id: "t2", merchant: "Salary · Fernway Ltd", category: "Income", amount: 4250, date: "Nov 13", ref: "BACS · Ref NOV-PAYROLL", }, { id: "t3", merchant: "City Transit", category: "Transport", amount: -32, date: "Nov 12", ref: "Monthly pass · Auto top-up", }, ] export default function BankTransactionDetails() { return (
{transactions.map((tx) => ( {tx.amount > 0 ? : } {tx.merchant} {tx.category} · {tx.date} 0 && "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" )} > {tx.amount > 0 ? "+" : "-"}${Math.abs(tx.amount).toFixed(2)} } />
{tx.ref}
))}
) }
